title: Back by popular demand, all the theatre I saw in January #theatrerecap
transcript: New Year, new theater. It's a January theater recap. Love an incredible cast playing a dysfunctional family. Is it too early to call best play of the year, Jordan Fisher? I'll miss you. Love new and development works like the Lonely Few, but make it straight. And country puppets are freaking cool. With some restructuring, this could be good. I feel like I missed a homework assignment before seeing this. But enjoyable. Caroline Fucking Bowman, y'all. The kids and I were confused, but ultimately stuck the landing. An important story I wish had better storytelling. Love when an ending is so perfect it makes me cry every time. Good, but wish it was great. Hailey Fucking Kilgore. What the. What the fuck? A simple yet charming night at the theater. The kind of structure I live for. Technology and theater can be freaking cool. A moving and communal experience. Sometimes a little distraction is exactly what the doctor ordered. Top three on stage cars, easy.
